name: Hard Rock Hotel Orlando
description: The most prestigious and rock-and-roll themed hotel at Universal Orlando Resort — Hard Rock Hotel is a spectacular Mediterranean-style resort hotel with direct water taxi access to both Universal parks, early park admission, a stunning pool with underwater speakers, multiple award-winning restaurants and the finest service at any Universal hotel.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Rock-themed room with free WiFi, resort pool access and early park admission.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Premium rock-themed room with upgraded views and furnishings.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spectacular suite with separate living area and complimentary breakfast.

name: Loews Portofino Bay Hotel
description: One of the most beautiful and romantic resort hotels at Universal Orlando — Loews Portofino Bay Hotel is a stunning recreation of the Italian Riviera fishing village of Portofino with cobblestone piazzas, harbour-side dining, a magnificent pool complex, early park admission and direct water taxi access to both Universal parks.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegantly themed Italian room with resort pool access and early park admission.

rooms.name: Bay View Room
rooms.description: Premium room overlooking the stunning Portofino harbour.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Magnificent suite with harbour views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Loews Royal Pacific Resort
description: A spectacular South Pacific-themed resort hotel at Universal Orlando — Loews Royal Pacific Resort features lush tropical gardens, a magnificent pool with interactive water play area, excellent dining, early park admission and direct water taxi access to both Universal parks. One of the best value premium hotels at Universal.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Tropical-themed room with resort pool access and early park admission.

rooms.name: Lagoon View Room
rooms.description: Premium room overlooking the tropical pool lagoon.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with pool views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Loews Sapphire Falls Resort
description: A vibrant Caribbean-themed resort hotel at Universal Orlando — Loews Sapphire Falls Resort features a spectacular pool with sandy beach, multiple restaurants, early park admission and water taxi access to both Universal parks. Excellent value for families visiting Universal Orlando.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Caribbean-themed room with free WiFi, pool access and early park admission.

rooms.name: Water View Room
rooms.description: Room with views of the Caribbean pool and waterfall.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with water views and complimentary breakfast.
